title: Check declaration, policy and generated contracts

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Check declaration, policy and generated contracts
steps.payload: Run ProjectCommandCatalogTests and ProjectCommandInvocationTests in EditMode; run MCP project-command/job negative tests and both generated-schema/token checks. Inspect fixture and bridge asmdefs for Editor-only platforms. Verify denied/disabled commands, invalid scope, duplicate identities, schema changes, output limits and audit payload exclusion.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: No player/runtime exposure or direct per-command dispatch.
Deny bypass requires gate off plus confirmation; scope/schema/disabled boundaries remain enforced.
Generated checks and schema snapshot pass; audit omits argument/result values.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
